name: Whiskey and Gin
source:
Theo enters a bar to drown out his sorrows, after finding out that his fiancé cheated on him with his brother.  After a short moment, a handsome man sits next to him and they converse about their failed relationships. When Theo wakes up the next morning, he finds that he may be developing complicated feelings for the gentleman.
